SMTO-UI-0003 — A required field is empty

GUID: ee84c4a3-81c6-4de5-bf95-ccb994ac5d58
Slug: ui-required-field
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • A box on this form that must be filled in is empty, so SMTO didn't accept the form.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look for a box on the form that is highlighted, marked as required, or still empty, and fill it in. SMTO can't continue until every required box has a value.
  2. Select the form's save or send button again. With the box filled in, the form can pass this check.
  3. If you can't tell which box is empty, copy what you entered, reload the page and fill in the form again. Reloading resets the form, which can show which box still needs a value.

What success looks like

  • The form saves or sends without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the name of the form you were filling in. Don't keep submitting the same form unchanged; it will be refused the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A form submission was refused because a required field had no value (retained compatibility alias; no current direct producer was found in source).

What this means

  • This compatibility alias denotes a missing required form field, but no current direct producer selects it in reviewed source. No direct current emitter for this retained alias was found. Inspect the original occurrence and current control state before assuming a particular validation ran or a submission was prevented.

Why this can happen

  • This compatibility alias denotes a missing required form field, but no current direct producer selects it in reviewed source.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the original form and its actual marked field rather than guessing which input is required.

How to fix it

  • ui_required_field is a retained alias with no current direct producer; current forms use their own required-field validation. Use the stage and transport details in Technical details to identify the form, fill the empty required control, and if a current form still emits this alias, map it to that form's specific validation error.
  • Complete the indicated field before submitting.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The current form's own required-field validation accepts the intended input.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • No direct current emitter for this retained alias was found. Inspect the original occurrence and current control state before assuming a particular validation ran or a submission was prevented.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
